crossRefs.note: Should your boastings make men hold their peace? When you mock, will no man make you ashamed?
They have gaped on me with their mouth. They have struck me on the cheek reproachfully. They gather themselves together…
Surely there are mockers with me. My eye dwells on their provocation.
“But he has made me a byword of the people. They spit in my face.
Allow me, and I also will speak; After I have spoken, mock on.
“But now those who are younger than I have me in derision, whose fathers I considered unworthy to put with my sheep…
All those who see me mock me. They insult me with their lips. They shake their heads, saying,
“He trusts in Yahweh. Let him deliver him. Let him rescue him, since he delights in him.”
Like the profane mockers in feasts, they gnashed their teeth at me.
They braided a crown of thorns and put it on his head, and a reed in his right hand; and they kneeled down before him…
Others were tried by mocking and scourging, yes, moreover by bonds and imprisonment.
My friends scoff at me. My eyes pour out tears to God,
He will call on me, and I will answer him. I will be with him in trouble. I will deliver him, and honor him.
‘Call to me, and I will answer you, and will show you great and difficult things, which you don’t know.’
But as for me, I will look to Yahweh. I will wait for the God of my salvation. My God will hear me.
He who walks in his uprightness fears Yahweh, but he who is perverse in his ways despises him.
They ridiculed him. But he, having put them all out, took the father of the child, her mother, and those who were with…
The Pharisees, who were lovers of money, also heard all these things, and they scoffed at him.
Now when they heard of the resurrection of the dead, some mocked; but others said, “We want to hear you again…

translations.web: I am like one who is a joke to his neighbor, I, who called on God, and he answered. The just, the blameless man is a joke.
translations.bsb: I am a laughingstock to my friends, though I called on God, and He answered. The righteous and upright man is a laughingstock.
translations.kjv: I am as one mocked of his neighbour, who calleth upon God, and he answereth him: the just upright man is laughed to scorn.
translations.asv: I am as one that is a laughing-stock to his neighbor, I who called upon God, and he answered: The just, the perfect man is a laughing-stock.
